measurement.comparison: Actual pinned prepare_letter called on a copy of each full original int16 clip. A forwarding-only clean_onset observer records the real input slice.
measurement.activity: Whole original and derived clips at 10ms RMS bins, relative levels .1%, .5%, 2%, and 5.5%. Activity thresholds never decide crop boundaries in this tool.
measurement.sample_preservation: The original archive, all1430 member hashes, individual bank/index/range/clip hashes and PCM decoding roundtrips are verified. Originals remain in the unchanged raw ZIP.
measurement.safety: Any removed nonzero sample is reported. It may be noise or speech. The signal measurement does not prove phonetic silence or preservation of quiet consonants/natural tails.
measurement.candidate_scope: Fresh research output only; no manifest, install, active hook, model inference or rerender of source recordings.

actual.interpretation: The existing policy shortens the heuristic low-energy lead, but removes nonzero original samples in every tested clip. No actual phoneme-alignment or native-listener proof is available, so raw and derived banks remain inactive.

specific_regressions: Quiet fricative attack and natural tail are flagged when the existing policy drops nonzero samples.
Original PCM roundtrip and actual observed policy crop window are preserved.
Observer always restores the original cleaner, including exceptional paths.
ZIP original names are checked before Windows ZipInfo slash normalization can hide a backslash.
Per-profile bank filenames, actual flat index, clip ranges and checksums are enforced.
All8excluded identities are rejected before bank access.
No acceptance or activation is inferred from candidate timing or nonzero PCM.

open: Native phonetic onset/tail review for all quiet Arabic consonant names.
Independent acoustic alignment against complete original samples.
Actual NVDA keyboard echo and audible-onset validation.
A reviewed future14 activation hook bound to installed package, names, vector, index/audio and resource epoch.
